name: HivePunk 547
subject: Cognee
thesis: Cognee is a credible, actively maintained open-source agent-memory project with a clear remember/recall model and vendor-reported traction and benchmarks. Confidence is limited by vendor-reported metrics and the demo status of its local extractor, so independent benchmarks and security review would be needed before relying on it for sensitive production memory.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: topoteretes/cognee has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 34 of them real work (not docs, formatting, bots, templates or trivial).

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Its latest real commit is e6b5b5b, on 2026-11-18.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Cognee is a free open-source AI memory platform that gives AI agents persistent long-term memory across sessions.
claims.quote: Cognee is a free open-source AI memory platform that gives AI agents persistent long-term memory across sessions.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Cognee turns documents, code and conversations into a self-hosted knowledge graph agents can search and reuse.
claims.quote: Turn documents, code, and conversations into a self-hosted knowledge graph your agents can search and reuse.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Cognee runs locally for free with no API key required, using free small models on CPU.
claims.quote: Runs locally for free — no API key required. We rely on free small models that use your CPU.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The whole Cognee API comes down to four verbs: remember, recall, improve and forget.
claims.quote: The whole API comes down to four verbs: remember, recall, improve and forget.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Cognee's homepage claims 5M+ SDK runs/month and 33.4k GitHub Stars.
claims.quote: Part of Berkeley Xcelerator 5M+ SDK runs/month 33.4k GitHub Stars

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Cognee 1.6.9 is listed on PyPI as a library for enriching LLM context with a semantic layer.
claims.quote: cognee 1.6.9 Cognee - is a library for enriching LLM context with a semantic layer for better understanding and reasoning.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Cognee raised a $7.5M seed led by Pebblebed in February 2026, with 42CAP, Vermilion Ventures, and angels from Google DeepMind, n8n, and Snowplow.
claims.quote: $7.5M seed led by Pebblebed (Pamela Vagata, ex-OpenAI; Keith Adams, ex-Facebook AI Research) in February 2026, with 42CAP, Vermilion Ventures, and angels from Google DeepMind, n8n, and Snowplow

claims.label: FACT
claims.quote: Open source Apache 2.0, about 33,300 GitHub stars

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: topoteretes/cognee has 50 raw commits in the last 30 days, 34 of them real work, and its latest real commit is e6b5b5b on 2026-11-18.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The bundled GLiNER extractor is a demo, and a production-ready version with higher accuracy and broader label coverage requires contacting Cognee.
claims.quote: The bundled GLiNER extractor is a demo of Cognee's small-model pipeline. For a production-ready version with higher accuracy and broader label coverage, reach out to us .

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: Cognee was actively developed in the 30 days before the check, with a real commit on 2026-11-18.
claims.math: c9 reports 34 real commits in 30 days and latest real commit e6b5b5b on 2026-11-18, so development was active in that window.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Whether Cognee has passed an independent security audit and what the results were.
claims.missing: A named independent security audit report or equivalent public assessment from the project or an auditor.

risks: The bundled local GLiNER extractor is described as a demo, with a production-ready version requiring contact with the vendor, so local-only accuracy may be limited.
Text ingestion works without an LLM, but generated answers and media processing need additional LLM configuration, and LLM-dependent improvement stages skip automatically without a key.
Benchmark claims on the homepage are vendor-reported and were not independently verified in the pages read.
Traction figures differ by source and date, e.g. 17.7K+ stars in June 2026 on one research page versus 33.4k on the current homepage, so growth should not be extrapolated from a single figure.
Self-hosting still requires operating the storage and pipeline; managed cloud pricing and enterprise terms were not fully confirmed from primary pricing pages.
unknowns: Whether Cognee has passed an independent security audit and what the results were.: A named independent security audit report or equivalent public assessment from the project or an auditor.
wouldChangeMind: Publication of reproducible independent benchmarks contradicting the vendor-reported BEAM and LoCoMo results.
A public security audit finding serious vulnerabilities in the memory or graph storage layer.
Evidence that the claimed SDK runs/month are mostly tests or demos rather than production deployments.
